boons.title: Boons
boons.text:
Boons
Boons
Boons
 are special 
treasures
 with powerful effects and special rules.
Boons are not acquired like normal treasures, they are not rewarded for taking 
golden characters
 or completing 
Quests
. Boons are gained through cards’ effects, such as 
Orpheus
 giving Boons if you have a cracked heart.
Boons have a condition, similar to 
Quests
, which must be met before you get their effects.
Notes
Boons reward other cards or play powerful 
spells
. After gaining a Boon’s reward, it disappears (it no longer counts towards 
Treasure Hoard
).
Unfinished Boons you already have cannot be options in new Boon discovery shops. You can rediscover Boons after they’ve been completed, and complete them again.
Boons are treasures, they are affected by treasure-copying or treasure-stealing effects.
Boons were introduced in Galaxy’s third set, 
Mythbound: Prophecies of the Nether Realm
.
			Close

buffs.title: Buffs
buffs.text:
Buffs
Buffs
In Galaxy, buffs are usually permanent. Once a 
character
 buff increases its attack or health, it keeps that buff for the rest of the game.
The buff will apply in all future 
fights
, and future copies of that character (such as 
Silvers
 or 
Goldens
) include that buff when they appear in the 
shop
.
= 181px)"/>
Notes
If you buff a character during a fight, it keeps those buffs when you return to the shop.
If you 
summon
 a character during a fight and buff it (for example, summoning a character with 
Goodie Bag
), the summoned character retains the buff when summoning it again in a future fight or seeing it in the shop.
If you 
transform
 a character into a new one, the new character retains all the buffs from the original.
Buffs to card abilities are also permanent, and carried on through transformations. For example: if the +1/+1 ability on 
Snow Ball
 is buffed up to +6/+6, then Snowball is transformed into 
Frankenstein
, Frankenstein’s ability would give 
+7/+7
 instead of +2/+2.
Slot buffs
 to your board are permanent. Since they are tied to the 
slot
 and not the character, they remain if the character there changes.
Auras
Some card abilities improve characters’ stats without giving a permanet buff. These "aura" effects are worded in a way where the card needs to be on your 
board
 in order to provide the buff.
Most 
support
 abilities are aura effects.
Since these effects are constantly checking, if the condition is changed or the 
character
 is removed, those effects no longer apply.
For example, 
Moonshadow
 grants other support characters 
Ranged
. When Moonshadow is KO’d, those characters lose Ranged.
			Close

captains.title: Captain
captains.text:
Captain
Captain
Captains are the champions of Galaxy, and your partners as you journey throughout the magical worlds. Before each game begins you 
select one Captain
 for the game, and one of their 
decks
 to shuffle into the 
shared card pool
.
New premium captains are released each month. They all automatically become 
FREE
 for all players 2 months after their release.
Notes
Most captains begin the game with 3 full hearts (see 
Heart Damage
).
Each captain has their 
own collection
 of 
collectible cards
 that you 
unlock through playing
.
Cosmetics
After unlocking 50 collectible cards for a captain, you gain their Diamond frame to show off your mastery of that captain.
"Costumes" are available for each captain, letting you change their look with alternate-artworks or variants that change the original art’s look.
Frame banners change the bottom half of the captain’s frame.
			Close

character-tier.title: Characters
character-tier.text:
Characters
Characters
Characters are the primary card type in Galaxy that you interact with each turn. Characters are gained by recruiting them from the 
shop
 to your 
board
.
Characters fight one another in the 
fight phase
, each dealing damage using their Attack (the number on the left) and receiving damage against their Health (the number on the right). When a character’s health reaches 0, they are KO’d and you will see them again when you return to the shop.
Most characters have ability text that gives them special bonuses throughout the game - see these by zooming on the card.
Each character has a 
rarity
, shown by the gem at the bottom of their card frame. This determines when it starts appearing in the shop and what 
treasure
 it finds when 
goldened
.
Common
Uncommon
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Gem-icons for each rarity
Notes
Characters can have one or more 
faction types
, which are displayed on the card’s frame on zoom.
Recruiting a character consists of dragging it from the shop to your 
board
 or to the 
bank
.
Bronze, Silver, and Golden versions.
The second time you see a character in the shop it will be 
Silver
 and recruiting it will grant you a Bonus Shop.
The third time you see a character in the shop it will be Golden and recruiting it will grant you a Bonus Treasure Shop.
			Close

spells.title: Spells
spells.text:
Spells
Spells
Starting on 
Turn 3
, your 
shop
 expands to include not only 3 
characters
 but also 
1 spell
. Spells behave differently than characters as they have no stats, feature a distinct spell frame, and are one-time use only. To cast a spell, simply drag it down onto your 
board
 area (some spells have a specific target, while others do not).
= 181px)"/>
Notes
To cast a spell that targets a specific character, drag it directly onto that character.
If a spell specifies it targets a 
slot
, drag it to the character currently in that slot. This still counts as casting the spell 
on
 a character (for effects like 
Ironcast Dragon
).
Casting a spell uses up your shop, you are choosing the spell instead of recruiting a character that turn.
You cannot 
bank
 spells. If you’re granted a Bonus Spell, you 
must cast it
. Be careful!
While spells do not show 
rarity
 gems on their card frames, they do have rarities (which you can see on card zoom) and follow the same 
shop rarity progression
 as characters.
Some spells only appear under specific circumstances. For example, 
Candy
 spells appear if you play with a Candy captain or Candy characters in your 
deck
.
			Close

treasures.title: Treasures
treasures.text:
Treasures
Treasures
Treasures are permanent bonuses that help you throughout a game of Galaxy. You earn them in various ways throughout the game and they exist only during the active game.  The most common ways to earn treasures are by recruiting the 
golden
 (third copy) of a 
character
 or by completing a character’s 
quest
.
When gaining treasures:
"Discover" or "Choose" means selecting from a treasure shop with 3 choices.
"Get" a treasure means automatically gaining it directly.
"Collect" occurs any time a treasure is added - whether by selecting it or getting it directly.
Notes
After earning a large number of treasures, a treasure chest icon appears. Click it to see all your treasures.
Treasures cannot usually be destroyed, unless by their own effects. There is maximum cap on collected treasures however, and gaining new treasures after that point removes older ones.
Treasures discovered by characters match the 
rarity
 of the character that discovered them.
The 
Treasure Hoard
 ability grants a character a +1/+1 
buff
 for each Treasure you own.
			Close
